note: Dated first-party observations of the Hotspawn pick'em contract. Read with the fetch tool and a runner-side probe during session 1112299f; the four-hour pipeline does NOT refresh this file. Each row carries its own source URL and observation time. 'derived' rows are arithmetic on verified rows; 'unverified' rows are published blank on purpose.

observations.claim: Points per correct pick scale with tier: C = 2, B = 3, S = 7 (floor of 2 x 1.25 x tier multiplier 1 / 1.5 / 3).
observations.how_verified: All 80 CS2 records in the saved fixture-API response satisfy offered_points = floor(base_points x product of points_breakdown multipliers): 57 C-tier = 2, 19 B-tier = 3, 4 S-tier = 7. Lobby cards read 'Points available 7 pts - Tier S x3 - Multiplier x1.25' for Aurora vs 9z.

observations.claim: Picks lock before the scheduled start. The rules page says 5 minutes; every one of the 80 fixture records carries lock_offset_sec = 360 (6 minutes).
observations.how_verified: Rules page re-read in full on 2026-10-15; lock_offset_sec = 360 for 80 of 80 saved records. The conflict is published, not normalised: submit at least 6 minutes before the start to be safe.

observations.claim: Only correct picks earn points; higher tiers earn more; consecutive correct picks earn a streak bonus whose formula is not published.
observations.how_verified: Rules page text ('Earn points for every correct pick. Higher tier matches reward more points.' / 'Get bonus points for consecutive correct picks.'). No formula appears anywhere on the page, so the streak bonus is left blank and flagged unverified.

observations.claim: Forfeited matches void all picks (no points awarded or deducted); cancelled matches cancel all picks.
The weekly leaderboard window is Monday 12 Oct 2026 00:00:00 UTC to Sunday 18 Oct 2026 23:59:59.999 UTC (week id 270, status OPEN). The lobby countdown, cutoff and week end are all that same instant.
observations.how_verified: Read from the same public JSON the lobby embeds and calls (/api/v1/week-prizes/widget). Cross-check: the lobby's countdown of 3d 01h 37m 29s at about 22:25Z on 15 Oct points at the same instant to within the two-minute uncertainty of the read.

observations.claim: Weekly prizes are rank-based: 1st $400 Steam voucher, 2nd $200, 3rd $100 (one each), places 4-10 $50 each (seven vouchers); no country restriction is listed; the lobby adds a minimum of 10 picks to qualify.
observations.how_verified: Prize rows read from the weekly-prizes JSON (ruleType RANK, quantityTotal 1/1/1/7, countryMode ANY, minPoints null, none claimed yet). The 10-pick minimum is lobby text, not an API field, so it is shown as lobby text.

observations.claim: Weekly leaderboard top 10 points at the observation: 160, 123, 122, 84, 81, 78, 68, 66, 65, 63. The 10th place (last prize place) stood at 63 points.
observations.how_verified: Lobby leaderboard widget. Player names are deliberately not copied.

observations.claim: Lobby CS2 filter totals: 86 fixtures (S 2 + B 31 + C 53); the page header says 111 matches this week across all games.
observations.how_verified: Lobby filter chips read; 2 + 31 + 53 = 86 checked by arithmetic. The collector's reconciled inventory at 22:25:16Z was 86 = 22 upcoming + 64 past-start records still labelled 'scheduled'.

observations.claim: The lobby shows 22 actionable cards: 15 under 'Closing Soon' and 7 under 'Upcoming'. The 64 other fixtures in the API have start times in the past but status 'scheduled'.
observations.how_verified: Cards counted on the lobby page; 22 equals the 'upcoming: 22' count in the collector's publication annotation of production run 38816949473.

observations.claim: Hotspawn's player base is small: S-tier fixtures had 13-16 pickers and B/C-tier fixtures starting from 14 Oct had 39-80 pickers at the 08:36Z snapshot.
observations.how_verified: total_picks in the saved fixture-API records (16 and 13-16 also appear on the Gothic vs Lavked B-tier fixture). Samples this small make '% picked' noisy, which is why the strategy page only ever shows it as labelled leverage context.

observations.claim: Lobby times are rendered in the viewer's zone. The fetch rendering showed Aurora vs 9z at 10:00 while HLTV and Polymarket give 14:00 UTC (a 4-hour offset), so compare times using UTC from the fixture API.
observations.how_verified: Lobby card 'Oct 16, 10:00' for aurora-vs-9z-thunderpick-world-championship-2026-1080205 against the HLTV match page 2399412 (10:00 on its own rendering, countdown 15h 31m at the fetch) and the Polymarket event 'Tomorrow 2:00 PM'.

observations.claim: The server-rendered lobby pages are served from a CDN cache, so the fixture list embedded in their HTML can lag the live fixture API by more than an hour. A cache-busting query string returns a fresh render.
observations.how_verified: Runner-side probe (scripts/lobby_probe.py, GitHub-hosted runner): three plain reads 27 s apart returned identical bytes with X-Cache HIT and a growing Age (lobby 87-88 min, CS2 lobby 71-72 min); two reads with ?cb=<epoch> returned X-Cache MISS, Age 0. This explains intermittent 'lobby, CS2 lobby and fixture API disagree' failures: any fixture change inside the cache window looks like a disagreement. The collector now requests the fresh render, retries once and names the differing IDs when it still fails.

observations.claim: The weekly lobby hydrates four API calls: week-prizes widget, tenant configuration, the CS2 fixture list (86 records, no filter parameters) and a public permalink map. The tournament pages hydrate /api/v1/tournaments, a per-tournament record, a tournament fixture list and the same permalink map.

value.note: The permalink map is read only from the page's own embedded state; the collector never requests administrative endpoints.

observations.how_verified: Angular hydration state (script#ng-state) of each page parsed by the probe; paths, query strings and record counts saved in the evidence file.

observations.claim: Hotspawn's tenant configuration enables pick'ems, minigames and tournaments, and the games CS2 and LoL (default CS2).
observations.how_verified: Embedded /api/v1/tenants/slug/hotspawn body saved by the probe.

observations.claim: The Thunderpick World Championship has a separate tournament pick'em: 7 points for the correct team plus 5 for the correct score, 15 fixtures over 8 teams, and no stage or series multiplier configured. See the tournament section for prizes and the leaderboard snapshot.
observations.how_verified: Tournament API body read directly (tenantId=1) and the tournament page text; the official sentence is 'Earn 7 points for a correct team prediction and 5 points for the correct score.'
